item.title: ⚠️ Rumor About RSA Breaking Scientists are discussing an unconfirmed rumor that …
item.description: ⚠️ Rumor About RSA Breaking Scientists are discussing an unconfirmed rumor that OpenAI and Anthropic models may have solved fast factorization, the problem behind RSA. If true, HTTPS, SSH keys, certificates, PGP/GPG, digital signatures, crypto, and financial transfers could be affected. There is no confirmation, though some researchers report unusual AI-lab activity. Replacing RSA across the internet would take years. ✔️ RSA depends on the difficulty of factoring huge numbers ✔️ The rumor concerns OpenAI and Anthropic models ✔️ Post-quantum cryptography is already being developed ✔️ Hash-based encryption is one possible direction 👉 Link 👈 Treat the claim as speculation until independent researchers reproduce it. 💻 @program

item.description: 🎓 Research Papers Into Videos A new GLM-5.4 skill turns arXiv papers into two-minute educational videos in the style of 3Blue1Brown, known for visual explanations of neural networks and mathematics. AlphaXiv has also added short videos to research papers in its trends section. ✔️ Upload any document, including raw PDF files ✔️ Get a narrated video with detailed animations ✔️ The model highlights key ideas and suggests visual explanations 👉 Link 👈 Try it with a paper you want to understand faster, then compare the generated explanation with the original research. 💻 @program
